summary.text: Howard Watts is a Democratic Nevada Assemblymember for District 15 in Clark County, first elected in November 2018. The legislature lists him as chair of the Growth and Infrastructure Committee in the 2023 and 2025 sessions and as self-employed in public relations.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Watts was born in Las Vegas in 1987 and holds a B.A. in political science from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
His page lists him as a member of the Las Vegas Valley Water District Citizens Advisory Committee in 2016 and 2017 and of the Clark County Advisory Board to Manage Wildlife from 2015 to 2018.
Watts began serving in the Nevada Assembly in 2019 and chaired the Natural Resources Committee in the 2021 session.

His page lists him as co-chair of the Nevada Sportsmen's Caucus and vice chair of the Nevada Tourism Caucus since 2023, and as chair of the Joint Interim Standing Committee on Growth and Infrastructure for 2025-2026.
